comments.author: tomkachowski
comments.body_html: Are armour inserts in face shields planned to be added to the mods functionality?

comments.author: FiveF
comments.body_html:
No.
Face shields dont have armor inserts. The easiest way would be to allow the face shields to be connected to other helmets, but it would look bad and this mod doesnt do that.
